items: NEW ADMISSIONS (June 2022): Huzan Zubin Engineer (Std. IV) from Pune and Behzad Dara Bharda (Std. II) from Udwada.
SSC 2023: Varzavand Hormaz Dadachanji (87.88%), Hormazd Kerman Fatakia (88.00%, LD).
Navar (May 2022): Farsogar J. Bhesadia (Rustom Framna, Dadar), Arzzan Dordi (Vatcha Gandhi, Hughes Road), Berjis K. Bharda (Udvada), Zahan M. Turel (Surat).
Maratab (May 2022): Shahrukh K. Karkaria (Wadiaji Atash Behram), Hormaz K. Fatakia (Vatcha Gandhi, Hughes Road), Farmaan K. Dastur (Surat).
Navar (May 2023): Sarosh K. Bharucha at Rustom Framna Agyari, Dadar. Maratab (May 2023): Zhian M. Turel in Surat and Farsogar J. Bhesadia at Rustom Framna Agyari, Dadar.

Staff: Er. Sarosh H. Behram Kamdin (Bhantar) discontinued from 30 April 2022 and Mr. Udit Aggarwala (Maths-Science) from May 2022; primary teacher Mrs. Bhanushali left from January 2023. New teachers: Er. Cherag S. Desai joined as Jr. Bhantar teacher from November 2022; Kainaz Turel for French and Neelima Diwekar for Hindi.
4 withdrawals after June 2022, 3 of them after SSC: Sharukh K. Karkaria (Std. X), Aarish K. Karkaria (Std. III), Arzzan N. Dordi (Std. IX) and Behzad D. Bharda (Std. III).
Total Strength 2022-23: 14 students — 13 school + 1 college (Shyamak Dastur, FY BAF).
4 June 2022: the Institute re-opened for all students after a long period of closure on account of Covid.
September 2022 — gifts from donors: an Epson printer, 4 additional CCTV cameras, a 20-litre microwave oven and blankets.
Fun outings: students went for the Ekadashi Fair (Jul 2022) and 3 nature walks (Jul 2022).
Gujarati play on Khordad Sal, courtesy Er. Cyrus Dastur of Universal Theatres (Aug 2022), and the movie “Brahmastra 3D” at PVR Sion (Sep 2022).
On 25 September the Dadar Athornan Institute was featured in Mazda Multimedia's bi-monthly YouTube programme “Our Very Own”.

17 December: Annual Day of the Institute. About 170 guests gathered at the Mancherji Joshi Hall in the Institute's Annexe Building. Dasturji Khurshed K. Dastur presided over the function and Dr. Beheram J. Bunshah was the Chief Guest, accompanied by his wife Dinmeher, who distributed the prizes. The students' programme included a talk on Maratab and a short skit, “Let us Understand Chhaiye Ame Zarthoshti”, after which snacks were served.

21 January: educational field trip to Doongerwadi, organised with Empowering Mobeds. Er. Dr. Ramiyar Karanjia gave a talk on Dokhmenashini and held an interactive session; the students then visited the Vatcha Gandhi Agyari and had lunch.

29 January: meeting with Mr. Neville Sadri and Mr. Tamboly, with the parents and students of the Institute, about the WZO Trust scheme under which Rs. 5,000 per month is set aside against each student's name and compounded until he completes his Navar, Maratab and SSC, the cumulative amount to be handed over as a fixed deposit after SSC.
21 February: staff and students went for a one-day games outing and picnic to Della Adventures, Khandala, courtesy Mr. Jimmy R. Mistry.
21 April: Dasturji Dr. Jamasp Jamasp Asa visited the Institute and interacted with the students.

29 January — Cub Scouts Sports Competition: Pashang D. Karanjia — 50 m III, throwing cricket ball II, backward run III, 100 m II; Delyaz M. Panthaki — backward run I, backward run II, throwing cricket ball II.

19 February — All Parsi Sports: Maidyarem Chinoy won the under-12 Boys Championship trophy with 3 gold medals (100 m run, 300 m run and long jump) and 1 silver medal (relay); Zhian M. Turel won a gold medal in relay and a bronze in shot put; Berjis Bharda and Shahan Bhesadia each won a silver medal in relay.

26 February — Creative Child Genius Competition at J.B. Vatcha High School: Delyaz M. Panthaki 1st consolation, Maidhyarem K. Chinoy 2nd consolation, Farman S. Dastur 1st consolation. Zhian Turel won the 1st prize for General Knowledge and the 2nd prize for Space Quiz.
Students participated in Iran League competitions such as Shahnameh, Drawing, Parsi Song and Western Vocal from July to December 2022.

Gujarati Reading (12 Nov 2022): Varzavand H. Dadachanji I & Trophy; Berjis K. Bharda I; Huzan Z. Engineer II; Zhian M. Turel II; Farmaan S. Dastur II; Maidhyarem K. Chinoy III; Kaiwan K. Sidhwa and Shahan Hoshan Bhesadia — consolation.
Western Vocal (19 Nov 2022): Huzan Z. Engineer II; Maidhyarem K. Chinoy II; Varzavand H. Dadachanji II; Zhian M. Turel III.
Monajat (10 Dec 2022): Zhian M. Turel I & Trophy; Huzan Z. Engineer I; Kaiwan K. Sidhwa II; Delyaz M. Panthaki and Farmaan S. Dastur — consolation.
Shahnameh (21 Jan 2023): Zhian M. Turel Trophy & I; Farmaan S. Dastur Trophy & I; Delyaz M. Panthaki I; Huzan Z. Engineer II; Berjis K. Bharda II; Kaiwan K. Sidhwa III; Maidyarem K. Chinoy III.

Religious Quiz (4 Feb 2023): Farman S. Dastur and Delyaz M. Panthaki — 1st prize; Maidhyarem K. Chinoy and Berjis K. Bhadha — 3rd prize; Zhian M. Turel, Huzan Z. Engineer and Kaiwan Kurush Sidhwa — 5th prize.
